text: {"memo": "Intel Corporation (INTC) reported FY2024 revenue of $53.10\u202fbillion, a slight decline from FY2023\u2019s $54.23\u202fbillion, reflecting a modest contraction in top\u2011line growth. However, FY2024 profitability deteriorated sharply: net income turned to a loss of $18.76\u202fbillion (\u201135% margin) and operating income fell to a loss of $11.68\u202fbillion (\\u201122% operating margin), compared with FY2023 net income of $1.69\u202fbillion (3% margin) and operating income of $0.09\u202fbillion (0.2% margin). Diluted EPS swung to \u20114$4.38 per share in FY2024 from $0.40 in FY2023. Operating cash flow weakened to $8.29\u202fbillion in FY2024 from $11.47\u202fbillion a year earlier. The combination of shrinking revenue, widening losses, and lower cash generation signals continued execution risk. The steep net loss margin and reduced operating cash flow underscore the challenges ahead. One\u2011line view: INTC remains a high\u2011risk, turnaround play with limited near\u2011term catalysts."}
